title: Businesses with ugly AI menu redesigns
summary: A critical commentary on businesses that have implemented AI-generated menu redesigns, highlighting aesthetic and design quality issues. The author documents examples of poorly executed AI-driven UI changes that resulted in visually unappealing menu interfaces.
problem_solved: Highlights the problem of AI-generated design outputs lacking visual coherence and aesthetic judgment.
why_valuable: Serves as a cautionary example for businesses rushing to adopt AI-generated designs without proper human review, demonstrating that AI can produce technically functional but visually jarring results.
